review.reason: Independently opened the official AHRQ Appendix A Lipid Conversion Factors at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK83505/ in a new wang Chrome tab on 2026-11-02. The visible mmol/L-to-mg/dL instruction explicitly specifies multiplication by 38.67 for total and HDL cholesterol. Reviewed both exact contracts and current K02 task_template.json; input columns, types, roles and units match, and output TC/HDL units match the fixed K02 analysis specification. Only TC and HDL are multiplied; ID, age, recorded F/M categories and BMI remain unchanged. This approves numerical representation only, not the target sex legend, assay/specimen or fasting equivalence, population transport, clinical model quality, source-feedback conversion, candidate construction, case admission, execution or global release. Original measured-reference lipids are already mg/dL and must not be converted again.
